description: Squat, heavy-clawed, cartoon-menacing crab warrior mascot.

api.auth: Bearer token read from the TRIPO_API_KEY environment variable only; never hard-coded or logged.

prompt: a stocky cartoon crab warrior mascot character, standing upright on two thick legs, two oversized heavy claws instead of arms held straight out to the sides in a T-pose, squat heavy cartoon-menacing build, thick red-orange shell armor, small angry eyes, full-body T-pose, legs apart and clearly visible, front facing, symmetric, no loose props attached to the body, clean topology, game-ready mascot character
rig_notes: Rigged with the v1.0-20240301 anatomical (Mixamo-like) biped skeleton, spec=tripo bone naming, 41 joints, 16 paired left/right limb bones (Clavicle/Upperarm/Forearm/Hand, Thigh/Calf/Foot, plus twist bones). Chosen because rig-check independently detected rig_type=biped for this model and the v1.0 biped path produced a structurally valid, symmetric skeleton with a correct GLB animation bake on this account (verified below) -- the crab is posed as a bipedal crab-warrior mascot (two legs, two claw-arms) rather than a true multi-legged crustacean rig.

animation.loop_verification: Computed world-space joint positions via forward kinematics at t=0 and t=duration from the sampled TRS tracks; max bone-position delta between the first and last frame across all named bones was 0.000996 model units (<0.001), i.e. the pose at the end of the clip is effectively identical to the start, so it loops without a visible pop.

mesh.triangle_rule: Sum over every mesh-referencing node's primitives: TRIANGLES=indices/3, STRIP/FAN=indices-2, using indices count when indexed else POSITION count; a mesh with no referencing node counts once.
mesh.pbr: pbrMetallicRoughness with baseColorTexture, metallicRoughnessTexture, and normalTexture all present
mesh.texture_resolution: 2048x2048 (normal map is PNG; baseColor and metallicRoughness maps are JPEG)
mesh.skin: 1 skin, 41 joints, mesh bound via JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 with the node's skin index set
